query: इन्द्रियाणि पराण्याहुरिन्द्रियेभ्यः परं मनः |मनसस्तु परा बुद्धिर्यो बुद्धेः परतस्तु सः |
expected_english: The senses are said to be greater than the body; but greater than the senses is the mind. Greater than the mind is the intellect; and what is greater than the intellect is he.
predicted_english: The senses, mind and intellect are said to be its seat; these delude the embodied soul, covering the knowledge.

query: अजोऽपि सन्नव्ययात्मा भूतानामीश्वरोऽपि सन् |प्रकृतिं स्वामधिष्ठाय सम्भवाम्यात्ममायया |
expected_english: Though birthless and deathless, and the Lord of all beings, I manifest Myself through My own Yogamaya, keeping My Natureunder control.
predicted_english: As the all-pervading ether is not tainted by reason of its subtlety, so seated everywhere in the body, the Self is not affected by the attributes of the body due to its attributeless character.

expected_english: Those whose mind and intellect are wholly merged in Him, who remain constantly established in identity with Him, and have finally become one with Him, their sins being wiped out by wisdom, reach the state whence there is no return.
predicted_english: The senses, mind and intellect are said to be its seat; these delude the embodied soul, covering the knowledge.

query: शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरमासनमात्मनः |नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम् |
expected_english: In a clean place, having established a steady seat for himself, neither too high nor too low, covered with kusha grass, deer skin, and cloth—
predicted_english: And the terrible sound, echoing through heaven and earth, rent the hearts of Dhritarashtra’s sons.

query: आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः पुनरावर्तिनोऽर्जुन |मामुपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते |
expected_english: Great souls, who have attained the highest perfection, having come to Me, are no more subjected to rebirth, which is the abode of sorrow, and transient by nature.
predicted_english: Sanjaya said: O king, having thus spoken to Shree Krishna, Arjuna again said to Him, “I will not fight,” and became silent.

query: भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया |त्वत्तः कमलपत्राक्ष माहात्म्यमपि चाव्ययम् |
expected_english: Because, O Lotus-eyed one, I have heard from you in detail about the origin of beings, and now I shall speak about your greatness.
predicted_english: Among the great seers, I am Bhrgu; among words, I am the sacred syllable OM. Among offerings, I am the offering of Japa; and among the immovables, the Himalaya.

expected_english: Those, however, who fully controlling all their senses and even-minded towards all, and devoted to the welfare of all beings, constantly adore as their very self the unthinkable; omnipresent, indestructible indefinable, eternal, immovable, unmanifest and changeless Brahma, they too come to Me.
predicted_english: Shutting out all thoughts of external enjoyments, with the gaze fixed on the space between the eye-brows, having regulated the Pranaand the Apanabreaths flowing within the nostrils;

query: उपद्रष्टानुमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वरः |परमात्मेति चाप्युक्तो देहेऽस्मिन्पुरुषः परः |
expected_english: In this body, the soul is indeed the Supreme Soul. Being the witness, it is the seer; being the giver of true knowledge, it is the approver; being the sustainer of all, it is the supporter; being the enjoyer of life, it is the enjoyer; being the lord of Brahma and others, it is the great Lord; and being pure consciousness and bliss, it is called the Supreme Soul.
predicted_english: Arjuna said—O Lord! I see in Your body all the gods and also the hosts of various beings, Brahma seated on the lotus, the great god Shiva, and all the sages and divine serpents.
